questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was important for me, that I was as far away from home as possible, as I thought this would give me the best opportunity to just fully immerse my self in the experience.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Exchange was the best decision I took! it did not disappoint at all, and fully lived up to all my expectations and more. It has given me the opportunity to get friends from all around the world, but also experience study life in another country.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was okay. My university abroad had made very thorough lists and points important to remember.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: There was plenty of opportunity to get help from the university if you didn't know where to go, or where to find things.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I found housing by talking to other people I knew had been at the same destination. they know all the tricks! a lot of housing around the world is accommodated by mouth-mouth principle, and it is also how you can find the cheapest and best possibilities.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is a very nice way to meet other people than them at your own university, and it is a good way to be more independent.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Really not very easy. There were so many different places to find information on which and what courses I could take. There were so much reading, and difficulty finding what I was able to take.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Can't remember..

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The university had a very helpful team, that answered e-mails very quickly.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Kind of successful. I changed one out of four courses when I arrived.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Set of A LOT OF TIME. And apply in good time as well, because the spots might fill up quickly. Remember to check at your university when their application date is for courses.
